What is Krafty Bot?

You tell a Bot what you need done. It works through the steps in your apps and on a cloud computer, keeps going after you log off, and checks with you before anything goes out.

See how it works

  1. Describe the job

    Tell a Bot what you need. A few questions and it’s set up.

    “Draft replies to my unread emails”“Find 10 businesses that need a new site”“Every Friday, recap my week”“Draft replies to my unread emails”“Find 10 businesses that need a new site”“Every Friday, recap my week”
    “Find a time for a call with Leo”“Chase my overdue invoices”“Turn this doc into a launch checklist”“What’s blocking the next release?”“Find a time for a call with Leo”“Chase my overdue invoices”“Turn this doc into a launch checklist”“What’s blocking the next release?”

  2. Connect the apps it needs

    You sign in yourself, and can disconnect any time.

  3. Let it work

    It works in your apps and on its own computer.

    Working

  4. Review and approve

    Changes to your connected apps wait for your OK.

    Inbox wants to send

    Re: Launch date

    DiscardApprove Sent

Hand it the whole task

Krafty doesn’t stop at telling you how. It opens the sites, reads the threads, does the steps, and comes back with what it found and what needs your OK. Message it from your laptop or your phone.

One Bot per job

Start with one Bot. Add another when you have more to hand off, like your inbox or the next release. They can run at the same time, pass work to each other, and keep going after you log off.

Signs in where you do

Connect Gmail, GitHub, and the other apps you use. Sites without an integration work in a browser.

Do it once, then every week

Get a task right in chat once. Then say “do this every Friday” and it runs on schedule without you.

Remembers what you tell it

Tell a Bot once how you like things done. It saves a note and uses it in every chat after that.

Bots hand off work

Put a few Bots in one chat, or have one brief another. You can follow every handoff in the thread.

What would you hand off first?

Answer what actually needs you. Finds the emails that need a reply, drafts answers in your voice, and holds every send until you approve it.

See more use cases

11:08 AM

check my email, find anything i need to respond to, and draft the replies. don't send anything yet.

Went through 46 emails since yesterday. 4 need a reply from you. The rest are receipts, newsletters, and threads you’re only cc’d on.

Leo’s matters most. He wants to know if the site can launch a week early. The draft offers a soft launch on the 20th and keeps the full launch on the 27th.

New emailReady to send
From
drew@kraftybot.app
To
leo@harborcoffee.example
Subject
Re: Launch date

Hi Leo,

We can do a soft launch on the 20th so you can share it with your regulars. The full launch, with online ordering, stays on the 27th.

Does that work for you?

Drew

send leo's. i'll look at the other three tonight

Sent to Leo. The other three drafts are waiting here.

Free

  • One-time $1 AI allowance

Pro

More Bots, more apps, and hours of computer time.

  • Up to 50 bots
  • Unlimited connected apps
  • $10 AI allowance each billing period
  • 50 hours of cloud computer time each billing period
  • Persistent computers, memory, and group chats

Start free with one bot, one connected app, a one-time $1 AI allowance, and 5 minutes of computer time, once. Hours of computer time need Pro. Founding offer: the first 50 new Pro subscribers can use code FOUNDING50 to pay $8/month instead of $20 for as long as they stay on Pro. View your usage

Check in from anywhere

Krafty runs in your browser. Start a task on your laptop and see how it went from your phone.

Open the appDesktop and mobile browsersCreate your first BotFree to start

Set it up your way

Give each Bot a name, a job, and instructions in plain English. Tell it what to remember so you don’t have to repeat yourself.

Open your workspace

FAQs

Krafty Bot is an AI workspace where you hand Bots actual tasks, not just questions. Each Bot has its own memory and working instructions, and all the Bots on your account share one persistent cloud computer with a desktop and browser. Bots use the apps you connect, research the web, run routines on a schedule, and keep working after you close your browser.

Krafty is built around doing the task instead of explaining it. Bots work in the apps you connect and on a cloud computer with a browser, several can run at once, and they keep going after you close your browser.

No. Reading your connected apps needs no approval, but anything that writes to them, such as sending an email or updating a record, waits for you to approve it. You can choose to always allow a specific action for a specific Bot, except for high-risk actions.

Anyone with work they keep putting off: independent founders, freelancers, developers, and small businesses. Start free with one bot, one connected app, a one-time $1 AI allowance, and 5 minutes of computer time, once. More Bots and hours of computer time need a paid plan.

In your browser, on your laptop or your phone. Your workspace has a chat with each Bot, group chats, and an Activity page for anything waiting on you.

Krafty is free to start with one bot. Pro is $20 per month for up to 50 bots, unlimited connected apps, a $10 AI allowance, and 50 hours of cloud computer time each billing period. Your usage page tracks both for the current period.

Yes. All the Bots on your account share one persistent cloud computer, so files and browser sign-ins carry over from one Bot to the next. Its files and applications survive when the computer pauses. Bots also work together through group conversations and handoffs.

Yes. A chat task keeps running after you close the tab. The computer pauses when idle and resumes when a Bot needs it. A task can still stop early if you reach your usage allowance or step limit, or if a provider is down.

Not automatically. Bots save notes to their memory and can recall them in any chat, so tell them what is worth remembering. Memory is separate from chat history.

Got something you keep putting off?

Hand it to Krafty. It’s free to start.
